Qiao nodded. "Of course, he did. How would this daughter-in-law dare lie about such a matter? Mother, think about it. Ever since the wedding date was set, although I was heartbroken, I did not try to stop it. Instead, I gathered my strength to prepare for Qingya’s wedding, all for the sake of our Marquis’s residence not being labeled as untrustworthy. You’ve seen all of this with your own eyes. But who could have expected such a turn of events?

We all agreed to Qingya’s marriage without hesitation. Why can’t we do the same for Qingshi now?

So, what should we do? I ask that you and the Marquis make a decision. If the Marquis insists on marrying off Qingya, I will not stand in the way."

Having been mother-in-law and daughter-in-law for so many years, Qiao understood Zhang’s true nature well. As long as her interests were threatened, she would easily change her mind.

Zhang thought about what Qiao had said and recalled how Qiao had indeed been sincerely preparing for Qingya’s wedding these past few days. Given this sudden change, it could only be the will of heaven.

Moreover, they were both her granddaughters. Qingya was the legitimate eldest daughter of the Marquis’s residence, raised by her side since childhood, and deeply loved by her. If the young general were still alive, Qingya’s marriage into the General’s residence would have made her the mistress of the household, which would have been a great help to the Marquis’s residence.

But now, the General’s residence had fallen from grace and was nothing more than an empty shell. Marrying Qingya off to them at this point would be a great loss for the Marquis’s residence.

As for the third girl, Qingshi, she had only just been acknowledged and was the daughter of that cheap woman, Su. Zhang had never taken a liking to her. In the short time since her return, she had already caused so much trouble. Who knew what else she would stir up in the future?

It would be better to marry her off as soon as possible to save themselves the trouble. It could also be considered a contribution from that mother and daughter to the family.

Zhang quickly made up her mind and shifted her gaze back to Yu Jingcheng. "What does the Marquis think? We were able to give up Qingya before. Why can’t we do the same with Qingshi now?"

The atmosphere in the Shouyin Hall instantly froze. No one spoke for a long time. Even the servants who were serving tea and water stood tense, not daring to make a sound.

Changing the bride at the last minute was a major event. Everyone outside knew that the one to be married into the General’s residence was the eldest daughter of the Marquis’s residence. Now, if they were to change it to the third daughter, who had only just been acknowledged after being raised outside for more than a decade, people were bound to gossip. Some might even suspect that this suddenly appearing third daughter was a decoy, brought back in haste by the Marquis’s residence to protect their own daughter.

But this change had been foretold by Master Yuan Kong of Tai Jue Temple, and the Old Madam Ning of the General’s residence had been present and had already accepted the change of bride. Now, it was up to the head of the Marquis’s residence to decide.

If they ignored heaven’s will and insisted on marrying off the eldest daughter, they would first have to get past the Old Madam. But if they changed it to the third daughter who had just returned...

It seemed that only the Marquis himself was reluctant.

The candles in the Shouyin Hall were not extinguished until the third watch of the night. Yu Qingshi did not know how their discussion had gone, nor did she care. She returned to her Ziteng Courtyard, ate and drank as usual, as if nothing had happened.

On the other hand, Tong’er was so anxious that she wanted to sneak out of the residence to find Su Cheng.

The young lady was facing such a big issue, and she had to inform the Madam as soon as possible. Only the Madam would wholeheartedly consider the young lady’s interests and stand up for her.

Tong’er no longer trusted the Marquis.

Yu Qingshi had to work hard to calm Tong’er down. "It’s too late for you to go out now. You might as well go back and get some sleep. Let’s see what Father decides to do first."

Today in the Shouyin Hall, she had continued to feign ignorance and had not spoken up, wanting to see how much her father and grandmother truly cared for her.

In her past life, they had quickly compromised. But in this life, she was not ready to give up. She wanted to see how long her father would hold out for her.

Moreover, why should she make it so easy for Qiao and her daughter to get what they wanted? She would rather endure the slow pain of a dull knife.

That night, many people in the Marquis’s residence tossed and turned, unable to sleep. The next morning, when everyone went to the Shouyin Hall to pay their respects, they saw that Qiao and Yu Qingya both had prominent dark circles under their eyes, clearly having had a sleepless night.

The Marquis also looked exhausted, as if he hadn’t slept well. His gaze toward her was filled with guilt.

Zhang saw her son’s expression and knew that he was still reluctant. She decided to speak for him.

She beckoned to Yu Qingshi. "Third girl, come here to your grandmother."

chapters.title: The Dowry
chapters.content:
Yu Qingci stepped forward obediently.

Madame Zhang took her hand and said, "You are a good child too. You saw everything that happened at Tai Jue Temple yesterday. There's no need for your grandmother to say more.

When this marriage was originally arranged for your second sister, she didn't utter a single word of unwillingness for the sake of our Bo Prefecture's reputation. Now that it falls upon you, though it is unexpected, your grandmother and your father hope that you, like your second sister, will consider the bigger picture and agree to this marriage for the honor of our Bo Prefecture."

Madame Zhang finished speaking and stared intently at Yu Qingci's face, afraid that she might show the slightest hint of reluctance.

Yu Qingci understood why Madame Zhang could say these words. After all, in both her past and present life, she had never developed any affection for this grandmother. It was impossible for Madame Zhang to protect her now. So, after Madame Zhang finished, she simply turned to look at her father.

Yu Jingcheng had been frowning deeply, his gaze fixed on her, filled only with reluctance and nothing else.

Yu Qingci understood.

She wasn't particularly disappointed. Instead, she knelt directly in front of Madame Zhang, lifted her head, and said calmly, "Grandmother, Father, Qingci is willing to marry into the General's Manor in place of Second Sister."

Everyone was shocked by her calm and composed words.

Madame Zhang even asked directly, "Are you serious? You are willing?"

She had thought it would take a lot of effort to persuade this girl.

Yu Jingcheng stood up and said, "Qingci, do you know that the man you are about to marry has already died in battle? Once you marry into that family, do you understand what your life will mean?"

Yu Jingcheng hadn't expected his daughter to agree so readily. He subconsciously felt that she might be too young to understand the implications of this marriage. He wanted to dissuade her but didn't know how to start. Thinking of his daughter, whom he had cherished since childhood, having to marry into a hopeless situation so soon after returning home, he was naturally extremely reluctant. He could only remind her to think carefully.

Yu Qingci countered, "Does it matter whether I know or not, Father? Can I choose not to marry?"

Yu Jingcheng: ...

Yu Qingci declared righteously, "Grandmother, Father, Qingci knows that the young general has already died in battle. I will only be able to enter the family holding his spirit tablet, and then live as his widow. I understand all of this.

Since I was a child, I have admired the heroes who gallop on the battlefield to defend our country. When I first returned to the manor and heard that Second Sister was going to marry into the General's Manor, I couldn't help but admire her. If Second Sister can do it, so can I. I believe Heaven will surely look favorably upon my sincere heart."

Since it was already decided that she would marry, she might as well make her words sound beautiful so that her father would feel more guilty towards her. Maximizing her benefits was the most worthwhile approach.

Sure enough, Yu Qingci's words left everyone stunned. Listening to her, it seemed that this girl had a broader perspective than all of them. Anyone who heard her words would be moved by her consideration for the bigger picture and her sincerity.

Madame Zhang's eyes flashed with relief. This granddaughter had finally done something that pleased her.

She beckoned Yu Qingci to her side, gently patted the back of her hand, and said earnestly, "Third girl, it's admirable that you understand so thoroughly. This way, your grandmother can rest assured. Your grandmother promises you that as a daughter of our Nanning Bo Prefecture, even after you marry into the General's Manor, the Bo Prefecture will always support you."

Madame Zhang then looked at Madame Qiao and said, "Since the third girl is so understanding, our Bo Prefecture must not treat her poorly. I think there's no need to prepare a separate dowry for the third girl. We can select a portion from the dowry originally prepared for Qingyan and give it to the third girl. Additionally, I will contribute three thousand taels of silver as her personal fund."

Yu Jingcheng said, "There's no need to make it so complicated. Just transfer the dowry prepared for Qingyan to Qingci's name as it is, including the silver notes I gave you privately before."

Madame Qiao heard the mother and son's words and her heart sank again. The dowry she had prepared for her daughter was meticulously arranged according to the standards of a legitimate eldest daughter, complete with rare treasures, prosperous shops, and farmlands. In the future, once married, it would undoubtedly be a spectacular dowry that would make her the talk of the town for miles around.

As for Yu Qingci, she had already made her plans. She would pick the least valuable items from the warehouse and supplement with some inexpensive items from Qingyan's dowry to maintain appearances. Even if the old master were to inspect, she could still manage to deceive him.

But she hadn't expected her husband to say that everything would be given to Yu Qingci. How could that be possible?

Madame Qiao dissatisfaction said, "Master Bo, Old Madame, this is not appropriate, is it? Regardless of whether Qingyan marries or not, those things are what I prepared for Qingyan. As the eldest legitimate daughter, it is only natural that she has a more substantial dowry.

As for Qingci, she is after all the younger sister. Her dowry cannot surpass that of her elder sister. What about the dowries for the other daughters below her? How will they be arranged?

Moreover, since she is marrying into the General's Manor to be a widow, having too much dowry might only end up benefiting the in-laws. In my opinion, it's better to keep the dowry modest and ensure that she can live without worries for the rest of her life."

Yu Jingcheng, standing beside her, suddenly flew into a rage, "How can you say such a thing? If that's the case, why did you prepare so much dowry for Qingyan in the first place? If you are so reluctant to part with that dowry, perhaps you should let Qingyan marry instead!"

This scared Madame Qiao into silence.

Madame Zhang also disapprovingly glared at Madame Qiao. She really didn't know how to speak properly.

Fearful that if they continued, her son might regret his decision, which would ruin everything, Madame Zhang spoke up, "Alright, since Master Bo insists, let it be settled this way. The dowry prepared for Qingyan, except for the private property that Madame Qiao herself contributed, the rest will be given to Qingci. For Qingyan, we can prepare a new dowry when her marriage is arranged. Our Bo Prefecture is not so poor that we cannot provide a proper dowry for our granddaughter."

Madame Qiao once again almost tore the handkerchief in her hands to pieces. Cold smiles filled her heart, but she had to muster her spirits and say, "Mother is absolutely right. It was this daughter-in-law who did not consider thoroughly. Although the third girl is not my biological daughter, her marriage is special. So, following Master Bo and Mother's wishes, the dowry originally prepared for Qingyan will be given to the third girl in full, without any reduction."

Yu Qingci quietly listened to their decision before gracefully complying, "Granddaughter thanks Grandmother and Father."

Madame Qiao, upon hearing this, was so angry that she was practically steaming. She had contributed both money and effort, yet she was not thanked?

Madame Zhang nodded in satisfaction, "Very well. Since the matter is settled, and the wedding day is not far off, Qiao, you must hurry and make preparations. The entire capital is watching this marriage. Our Bo Prefecture cannot afford to lose face. We must ensure that the third girl is married off in a grand and glorious manner."

With the old madam's final word, everyone breathed a sigh of relief. Only Yu Jingcheng felt a mix of emotions, looking at his beloved daughter with a gaze full of pity and helplessness.

As the master of the Nanning Bo Prefecture, there was nothing he could do to change this situation. He could only feel guilty towards his daughter. The only thing he could do now was to provide her with a generous dowry, so that her life in her married home would be more comfortable.

---

chapters.title: A Dream of Millet
chapters.content:
Following her mother back to the Haitang Courtyard, Yu Qingyan felt both wronged and relieved.

She was wronged by her encounter with Madame Liao, but thinking that she no longer had to marry into the General's Manor to spend her life as a widow guarding an empty house, she couldn't help but feel a surge of joy.

After sitting down, she couldn't wait to ask Madame Qiao, "Mother, is it true? Do I really not have to marry into the General's Manor to be a widow?"

Madame Qiao looked at her daughter with a loving expression and nodded, "Of course it's true. You heard what your grandmother and father said. Once they've made a decision, they won't change it. As for that girl, Yu Qingci, she has personally agreed to this marriage. There's no one to blame."

Yu Qingyan let out a long sigh of relief. After thinking for a moment, she said, "Ever since this matter arose, I have been so distressed that I couldn't eat or sleep. Now that it's finally resolved, Mother, may I host a tea-tasting banquet? I could invite the Liu family's elder sister and a few close friends to gather. A few days ago, my maternal grandmother specially sent me some fine autumn tea, which I haven't brought myself to drink yet. It would be perfect for entertaining my good friends."

The Liu family's elder sister she mentioned was the eldest legitimate daughter of the Liu family, whose head was the Minister of Works. She and Yu Qingyan had been close friends since childhood. A few days ago, the Liu family girl had hosted a chrysanthemum appreciation banquet and had sent an invitation to Yu Qingyan, but she had declined due to her depressed mood.

Now that the dust had settled, Yu Qingyan finally had the mood to socialize again.

Madame Qiao walked over and sat across from her daughter. She couldn't help but stretch out her finger and tap her daughter's forehead, sighing, "Tsk, you still can't control your temper. The marriage has just been shifted to that girl, and you can't wait to go out and socialize. Are you afraid your father won't notice your intentions?"

Yu Qingyan was taken aback for a moment before she understood.

Madame Qiao continued earnestly, "You must keep a low profile during this period. Before that girl gets married, stay at home and be a good sister to her. Spend more time visiting the Wisteria Courtyard when you have the chance. Let everyone see that you are a good sister who cares for your younger sibling."

Yu Qingyan smiled slightly, "Mother, I know what to do."

Madame Qiao nodded in relief.

As the wedding day approached, the entire Bo Prefecture began bustling with preparations.

Madame Qiao was busy day and night, personally selecting wedding dresses, arranging the bridal chamber, and organizing all the dowry items. She handled every detail herself to demonstrate her sincere care as the mistress of the household. Outsiders who saw this also felt that the Bo Prefecture truly valued this marriage and couldn't help but hold them in higher regard.

Yu Jingcheng received praise from his colleagues. Although he was burdened with worries, he expressed satisfaction with Madame Qiao's efforts upon returning home.

But thinking about the woman outside the manor who could take his life, he couldn't help but feel anxious and unable to eat or sleep. He could only delay the inevitable for as long as possible.

Yu Qingci was also struggling with how to explain this matter to her mother.

Her father had specifically sent someone to the General's Manor to pass a message. The marriage between the two families had been quite high-profile lately, so to avoid any more unexpected incidents, the matter of the sister replacing the bride should not be spread abroad for the time being.

The masters of both families had also strictly ordered their servants not to disclose the news. Therefore, the matter had not yet spread outside, and her mother still didn't know.

But she would have to tell her mother eventually. She couldn't let her mother and father fall out over this.

In her past life, when her mother found out that the Bo Prefecture wanted her daughter to marry in someone else's place, she disregarded her status and barged into the Shouyin Hall to confront Madame Zhang. This enraged Madame Zhang, who punished her with the family rules. In the end, her father intervened to save her mother and also ensured that she didn't have to go through with the marriage.

However, because of this, she and her mother had offended almost all the masters of the Bo Prefecture. Madame Zhang had come to despise them, and Madame Qiao and Yu Qingyan had hated them to the bone. Her father's heart had also grown cold towards her mother after the repeated storms, which gave Madame Qiao the opportunity to slowly drive her mother to her death.

Therefore, she had to find a way to persuade her mother.

Wait, she remembered that in her previous life, not long after entering the manor, the capital had experienced a rare heavy rainstorm. It was considered rare because it was accompanied by intense thunder and lightning.

Such weather usually only occurred in the summer. Now, it was almost deep autumn, yet there was both thunder and lightning. This caused a part of the main hall of the City God Temple in the west of the city to be struck by lightning, nearly causing a fire. Because of this, the heavy rain became a topic of discussion among the common people for a long time, as they all felt it was a very inauspicious omen.

Yu Qingci had an idea. She took the initiative to find her father and proposed that she wanted to leave the manor to visit her mother.

"This matter must be made known to Mother eventually."

Yu Jingcheng saw his daughter standing in front of him, obedient and considerate, and couldn't help but sigh. He immediately ordered the servants to prepare the carriage and took the siblings to Liuli Alley.

With the two children present, perhaps Su Chengniang would restrain her temper a little?

"You said what?"

Su Chengniang almost fainted upon hearing the words from Yu Jingcheng's mouth. The three of them were so flustered that it took a while to help her recover.

"Say it again. Where are you sending my daughter?"

After regaining her senses, Su Chengniang pounced on Yu Jingcheng. Her gaze was as sharp as a knife, as if she wanted to stab it into his heart.

Yu Jingcheng, full of guilt, said, "Chengniang, listen to me. This is something that cannot be avoided..."

"Don't call me that! No wonder the old madam suddenly agreed to let the two children return to acknowledge their ancestors. No wonder you were so eager to persuade us to return to the manor. It turns out you had it all planned, to use my daughter to replace your Bo Prefecture's daughter and escape the fate of being a widow!

How could you do this to us? You have such a cruel heart. I will fight you to the death!"

At this moment, Su Chengniang showed none of her usual calm and dignified demeanor. Yu Jingcheng was left in a state of dishevel by her shrew-like tirade.

The siblings had never seen their mother in such a rage and were also shocked. They watched helplessly as their father was scratched and pulled by their mother for a long time before they finally reacted and tried to intervene.

After much effort, Su Chengniang finally stopped cursing and crying. Yu Qingci helped her into the inner room and ordered the maids to bring hot water, personally helping her mother wash up and redo her hair and makeup.

She gently wiped away her mother's tears but forgot that her own face was also covered in tears. In both her past and present life, having a mother who wholeheartedly cared for her was her greatest blessing.

Su Chengniang looked at her daughter, whom she had raised like a precious jewel since childhood, and now she was being schemed against by the people of the Bo Prefecture. She couldn't help but feel a deep sorrow.

"Mother, do you believe in what people call a 'dream of millet'?"

Yu Qingci slowly recounted the dream of millet she had experienced.

She started from the time the three of them entered the Bo Prefecture together, talking about how her mother had to lower herself and endure humiliation for the sake of her and her brother after entering the manor, the arranged marriage, and the tragic end they all met. As she spoke, Su Chengniang's face grew paler and paler, her almond-shaped eyes fixed on her daughter with an expression of disbelief.

Yu Qingci continued, "Mother, everything I said is true. Whether you believe it or not, I do. That's why I believe the young general is not actually dead. Otherwise, how could the court have sent so many people to search for so long without finding his body?

There are many rumors about the young general in the capital, most of which praise him as a heroic figure who stands tall and upright. Therefore, I believe he is a man of integrity and honor.

Mother, think about it. If in the next three years, I marry into the General's Manor and help him keep his family, then when the young general returns, he will surely treat me well."

chapters.title: Convincing Her Mother
chapters.content:
The rest of the words could not be said. If she told her mother now that the young general would indeed return in three years, but not alone, and would bring a close female friend with him, her mother would surely make a fuss again.

"You say all this is too absurd. You wouldn't be lying to me just to put my mind at ease, would you?"

Su Chengniang looked at her daughter for a long time before speaking: "But what if your dream doesn't come true? What if the young general doesn't return in three years? What will you do then?"

Yu Qingci: "Even if the young general doesn't return in three years, what does it matter? It's not easy for women in this world. How many women can truly marry well and have a smooth life?

Since I have returned to the Earl's mansion, my future marriage will not be entirely up to my mother. Rather than facing an uncertain future, it's better to take a gamble. Even if I lose, I believe that with the character of the old madam of the General's mansion, I can live a peaceful life after marrying there."

Su Chengniang never expected her young daughter to have thought so much. She opened her mouth but didn't know what to say.

After all, she had once been the mistress of a high-ranking family, but when her maiden family fell into trouble, her mother-in-law immediately demoted her from wife to concubine.

Yu Qingci then told her mother a few small things from her dream that had already come true, and decided to take another gamble: "In my dream, I remember that three days later, there will be a heavy rain in the capital, accompanied by thunder and lightning. The lightning will even strike a corner of the City God Temple in the west of the city. The main hall of the City God Temple will almost catch fire, but fortunately, a downpour will follow immediately after the thunder and lightning, avoiding a greater disaster.

If you don't believe me, mother, why not wait and see."

Su Chengniang looked at her daughter's expression, which was even more ghost-like.

Yu Qingci took the opportunity to divert her attention and changed the subject to Yu Qingbai.

"By the way, mother, I have found a private tutor for Qingbai. You must have heard of his name. Why don't you guess who he is?"

Su Chengniang couldn't help but be startled again. Yu Qingci smiled and said, "It's the famous Li Ye, the old master of the capital, the former imperial tutor."

Su Chengniang: "Really? Is it really the great scholar Li? These days, I have also asked the neighbors about the famous scholars in the capital. I heard that this old master Li has retired for many years and no longer lives in the capital. He moved to a good place near the Tai Jue Temple in the suburbs to live in seclusion and has not accepted disciples for a long time."

At this point, Su Chengniang remembered that her daughter had just gone to Tai Jue Temple with the people from the Earl's mansion, and her eyes lit up as she asked again: "Did you really see the great scholar Li? I heard that this old master is very difficult to visit."

Yu Qingci smiled: "Since mother knows this old master, you should also know that besides his astonishing literary talent, he is also an unrivaled master of Go. Previously, I specifically asked mother for the Su family's heirloom Go manual to give to him."

Yu Qingci told Su Chengniang in detail about her visit to Li Ye at Tai Jue Temple, and even mentioned that she had solved the Go puzzle set by the old master with the help of the hints from her dream.

Su Chengniang was half-convinced and half-doubtful. Her daughter had received education in music, chess, calligraphy, and painting since she was young, and her Go skills were quite good among the women in the boudoir. However, it was still a bit far-fetched for her daughter to solve the old master Li's Go puzzle on her own. Could it be that she really got the hint from her dream?

Su Chengniang: "So you asked me for the Go manual to give to the great scholar Li. Why didn't you tell me earlier? I thought you were trying to please the people of the Earl's mansion."

Yu Qingci couldn't help but laugh: "How could I be so foolish? Mother's things are only for us to use. Forget about the people of the Earl's mansion.

Time is of the essence. Mother, why don't you talk to father later about letting my brother go and study under the master? Although my brother is young, he has been clever since he was a child. When he was studying in Youyang, he was often praised by his teacher. I believe that Master Li will eventually accept him.

Once my brother successfully finds a master, he can move out of the South Ping Earl's mansion and focus on studying with Master Li. After I get married, mother won't have to worry about us every day."

Even if Su Chengniang didn't say it, Yu Qingci knew very well that as long as her brother and she lived in the Earl's mansion for a day, her mother's heart would not be at ease for a day.

Su Chengniang slowly digested the few things her daughter said, and finally nodded: "Yes, finding a master is a big deal. Since you have already paved the way, we should naturally act quickly. I will talk to your father later and ask him to take Qingbai to see Master Li tomorrow."

She paused and sighed: "They say men's words are deceitful. I trusted him so much, but I never expected such a marriage to be waiting for me. If I had known, I would never have agreed to return to the capital with him. Now he has already harmed one of my children. If he cannot handle this matter for your brother, I will never forgive him."

Yu Qingci smiled and stood up: "With mother taking charge, father will not refuse. Then, daughter will accompany mother out."

In the main hall, Yu Jingcheng and his son were sitting restlessly, waiting. When they saw the mother and daughter coming out hand in hand, Yu Jingcheng quickly stood up and took big steps forward: "Chengniang, for the sake of the children, please don't be angry anymore. When you are angry, my heart is also uneasy."

As soon as Su Chengniang saw him, her just calmed down mood immediately flared up again. Yu Qingci, seeing the situation was not good, quickly tugged at her sleeve and whispered in her ear: "Mother, the important matter comes first."

Su Chengniang then forcefully suppressed her anger, walked over with a blank expression, and sat down on the chair: "I have something to tell you. Listen carefully."

Yu Jingcheng immediately sat down next to her: "Chengniang, speak. As long as I can do it, I will try my best."

Su Chengniang glared at him with her almond eyes and coldly looked over: "Do you mean that if you can't do it, you will just give up?"

Yu Jingcheng quickly shook his head: "I didn't mean that. I..."

Forget it, it's better to say less at this time.

So he lowered his head and continued to admit his mistake: "I said the wrong thing. Chengniang, you speak."

Su Chengniang told him about her daughter meeting the great scholar Li, and finally said: "You have already disappointed me with our daughter's matter. If you can't handle our son's apprenticeship this time, I, Su Chengniang, will immediately pack my things and take them back to our hometown, Youyang. From then on, we will go our separate ways, and all ties between us will be severed!"

Yu Jingcheng first felt nervous, but as he listened, his face showed extreme joy. He never expected that his young son would have such a good opportunity to study under the famous scholar Li Ye in the capital, and this was all arranged by his daughter in private.

He repeatedly nodded and agreed to put his son's matter to heart, and in a few days, he would take his son to pay respects to the master, ensuring that he would not delay his son's future and so on.

Su Chengniang saw that his attitude was sincere, so she didn't say anything more, but she absolutely would not give him a good face.

The family of four gathered together and quietly had dinner. Yu Jingcheng decided to stay with the children tonight and not return to the Earl's mansion, so he called Changfeng in and asked him to go back to the Earl's mansion to inform them.

---

chapters.title: Apprenticeship
chapters.content:
Su Chengniang heard this and her pretty face sank. She was about to tell him to leave alone, but remembering her daughter's words, she endured and kept silent. It was fine. When there was no one around, she could have a good talk with him.

So that night, the father and his two children stayed in Liuli Alley. Yu Qingci and Qingbai each had their own courtyards. Originally, Yu Qingci was going to return to her own courtyard to sleep, but Su Chengniang held her back: "Qingci, sleep with me tonight. Let's have a good heart-to-heart talk."

Thus, Yu Jingcheng could only pitifully go to the front courtyard to sleep alone.

The next day, after the three of them had breakfast with Su Chengniang, Yu Jingcheng instructed his children to stay and keep their mother company for the next few days. Only then did he take a carriage back to the Earl's mansion to report to Madame Zhang.

Yu Jingcheng naturally would not tell the truth in front of Madame Zhang. He only said how Chengniang was considerate of the bigger picture and, for the sake of the Earl's mansion, although she was reluctant to part with her daughter, she finally nodded and agreed to this marriage.

"Chengniang has a sincere heart towards our son. Feeling guilty, I took the initiative to let Qingci and Qingbai stay with Chengniang for these few days to keep her company. After all, after Qingci gets married, she may rarely have the chance to return to her maiden home."

Seeing that her son spoke sincerely and presented a fait accompli, Madame Zhang could not say much more. As long as this marriage was smoothly resolved, and the South Ping Earl's mansion was no longer in the limelight, being watched by others like a spectacle, she could finally breathe a sigh of relief.

Yu Jingcheng also mentioned Qingbai's upcoming apprenticeship, which was a good thing and did not need to be hidden.

Sure enough, when Madame Zhang heard that the master was the former imperial tutor, Li Ye, she immediately asked happily how this came about. Yu Jingcheng then repeated the story.

Of course, he did not mention that Qingci had secretly visited Li Ye at Tai Jue Temple that day without telling Madame Qiao and others. Instead, he directly attributed the matter to Su Chengniang, saying that she had arranged this for her son.

Madame Zhang listened happily, and her dislike for Su Chengniang lessened slightly. However, she soon thought of her eldest grandson, Yu Qingyun, who was currently studying at the Imperial College, and after some thought, she still said to Yu Jingcheng:

"Li Ye is a famous master of our time. It is a dream come true for scholars all over the world to study under him. This time, he is actually willing to assess the children of our South Ping Earl's mansion. This is truly a blessing from heaven. In my opinion, such an important opportunity should be given to Qingyun instead.

Qingbai is still young, and there's no rush for his apprenticeship. Even if he is brought to Master Li, it might not succeed. What if Master Li thinks that our Earl's mansion does not value this matter and sends a milk-smelling child to study, thus forming a bad impression of our Earl's mansion? Wouldn't that be terrible?

Qingyun is different. He is your eldest son and has been studying at the Imperial College all these years. His essays are often praised by his teachers. Previously, his teacher even asked him to prepare for next year's autumn imperial examination, showing great expectations for him.

Now that our Earl's mansion has such a good opportunity, we should naturally prioritize Qingyun."

Yu Jingcheng listened to his mother's analysis and couldn't help but smile bitterly. He could only remind her again that it was not Master Li who had taken a fancy to the children of the Earl's mansion, but Chengniang who had managed to secure this opportunity for her own son.

But Madame Zhang did not take it to heart and insisted on giving this opportunity to her eldest grandson, Yu Qingyun. Once the old lady had made up her mind, she was like a bull with a ring in its nose; the more he advised, the more troublesome things became. Yu Jingcheng simply stopped talking. However, in his heart, he planned to take Qingbai to pay respects to the master as soon as possible to avoid any unforeseen complications.

After a day, Yu Jingcheng took leave from his superior and hurried to Liuli Alley. He took Yu Qingbai, along with the apprenticeship gifts prepared by Su Chengniang, to visit Old Master Li at Jiyun Mountain.

The mother and daughter waited anxiously at home until the sky darkened before the father and son finally returned.

Su Chengniang rushed forward and asked repeatedly: "How was it? Why did it take so long to come back? What did the old master say?"

Yu Qingbai puffed out his chest and loudly declared: "Mother, sister, the master agreed to teach me!"

Yu Jingcheng also said joyfully: "Yes, Old Master Li agreed to test Qingbai for a period of time. As for whether they have the fate of master and disciple, it will depend on this boy's own efforts. This trip was truly not easy."

With this initial victory, the mother and daughter were overjoyed. Su Chengniang, delighted, kept asking Yu Qingbai about his apprenticeship, while Yu Qingci smiled and reminded her: "Mother, let father and brother wash up and eat first."

"Yes, yes, yes. Look at me, I'm so happy I've gone silly. Let's eat first, then we can talk slowly."

While the Liuli Alley was filled with harmony, in the South Ping Earl's mansion, Madame Zhang had also been concerned about her eldest grandson's apprenticeship. After waiting happily for two days without any news, she anxiously revealed this matter to her daughter-in-law, Madame Qiao.

Madame Qiao, upon hearing this, also joyfully muttered prayers to the Bodhisattva. The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law discussed for a while and decided to wait for the Earl to return that evening to urge him to put this matter on the agenda as soon as possible and to have Qingyun prepare for his apprenticeship in advance.

Thinking of this, Madame Qiao immediately sent a servant boy to the Imperial College to call back the young master so that he could know about this matter.

Although the Western teachers in the Imperial College were all renowned scholars of the current dynasty, the name of Old Master Li was like thunder to their ears. With his former status as the imperial tutor to the crown prince, which scholar in the world did not respect and admire him, and which one did not hope to study under the same master as the current emperor?

However, the servant boy who was sent had just walked out of the Earl's mansion gate when he bumped into Yu Jingcheng, who was returning from outside.

Yu Jingcheng saw that his mother had actually spread this matter, and his initial joy immediately diminished. He frowned with a headache and went to the Shouyintang.

The result was as expected. When Madame Zhang heard that her son had taken the initiative to take Qingbai to pay respects to Master Li, she immediately became angry:

"You are really something! You're getting more and more like the Earl, not even listening to your old mother's words. Qingyun is your eldest son. Instead of cultivating him wholeheartedly, you think of that Su woman's child for every good opportunity. How can you justify my hard work and the century-old foundation of our Earl's mansion?"

Although Madame Qiao did not say anything, her face was obviously dark with anger.

Yu Jingcheng had no choice but to patiently explain to the two women that it was not Master Li who had taken a fancy to the younger generation of the Earl's mansion. In short, this matter was originally paved by Chengniang herself for her son and had nothing to do with the Earl's mansion.

Moreover, with Qingci about to get married, if the Earl's mansion acted too excessively, it would inevitably hurt the hearts of this mother and her two children.

Madame Qiao listened silently without interrupting, a sarcastic smile appearing at the corner of her mouth, and her face grew colder and colder.

That cheap woman Su Chengniang, how dare she even try to snatch my son's good opportunity? Just wait a few more days. After your daughter marries my daughter, we will settle the score slowly!

As soon as she finished this vicious thought, a huge thunderclap suddenly rang out, startling Madame Qiao. Before she could figure out what was happening, a series of thunderclaps accompanied by several lightning bolts exploded in the sky. The night, which had already darkened, was occasionally lit up by the lightning, as bright as day.

chapters.title: Fulfillment
chapters.content:
The sudden turn of events immediately shifted everyone's attention. Madame Zhang looked outside and murmured, "It's this late in the season, how can there still be thunder and lightning?"

At this hour, it was not yet night. Many in the capital were caught off guard by the sudden thunder, some even terrified—how could there be thunderstorms in late autumn?

Fortunately, after a short while, the thunder grew quieter, and the night sky returned to calm, easing people's hearts.

However, starting from the next dawn, an even fiercer storm arrived, accompanied by torrential rain. The downpour lasted all day, and by evening, there was still no sign of it stopping.

A servant who had gone out shopping returned with news: that morning's lightning had struck the City God Temple in the north of the city, setting part of the main hall ablaze. Fortunately, the temple guards noticed in time and called for help to extinguish the fire. The timely heavy rain also helped douse the flames, preventing a disaster.

The people of the Marquis's mansion were shocked. Madame Zhang looked at the pouring rain outside and muttered to herself, "Who knows how long this rain will last? It's truly worrying."

Equally anxious was Su Chengniang. After her servants returned and reported the fire at the City God Temple, followed by the torrential rain, she couldn't help but believe her daughter's words a little more.

At that moment, she asked the same question as Madame Zhang: "Who knows how long this rain will last?"

Yu Qingzhi reassured her, "Don't worry. The rain will ease by evening and stop completely by tomorrow morning."

Su Chengniang: Let's see tomorrow.

That night, Su Chengniang tossed and turned, unable to sleep. She got up several times to open the window and check the rain outside. By the next dawn, the rain had indeed stopped, but Su Chengniang's heart was pounding like thunder.

In the evening, Su Chengniang went to Qingzhi's room, and the mother and daughter had a heart-to-heart talk.

Su Chengniang looked at her daughter with reluctance in her eyes: "Have you really thought it through, wanting to marry into the General's mansion? If you change your mind now, I will do everything in my power to protect you and call off this engagement. Whoever should marry, let them marry. My daughter doesn't need to clean up someone else's mess. At worst, I'll cut ties with your father, and the three of us will return to Youyang."

Even though her daughter's words about the thunder and lightning had come true, she still couldn't bear to watch her daughter marry into such a place.

Qingzhi was deeply moved. She gently hugged her mother and said, "My mother is the best and most beautiful mother in the world. Don't worry. Since I've agreed to this marriage, I will make sure to live well in the future. I will also protect you and my younger brother, ensuring that you are not bullied."

Seeing that she couldn't persuade her daughter, Su Chengniang sighed and took something out from her bosom, handing it to Yu Qingzhi. "This jade pendant has been with me since I was little. Your grandmother said it was my protective charm, and I must keep it safe without any mishaps. Now that you are getting married, I will give it to you. I hope that after you go to the General's mansion, you will always be safe and smooth."

Qingzhi, suppressing the emotion in her heart, took the jade pendant. It was a piece of exquisite Hetian jade, small and delicate, carved into the outline of a cicada. The entire piece was a gradient green, deepening towards the bottom.

Holding it in her hand, she first felt a coolness, but soon a warmth spread through her palm, indicating it was a rare and precious jade.

In her previous life, her mother had given her this jade pendant, but it was unfortunately deceived by the shameless Qiao Yuantao and given to Yu Lian, which she deeply regretted.

Now, the jade pendant was lost and found again. She must keep it safe and never let anyone take it away.

Yu Qingzhi: "Mother, rest assured. I will keep it safe."

Yu Qingzhi: "There is also an important matter that I need Mother and Father to address."

Su Chengniang immediately perked up and asked, "What is it?"

Yu Qingzhi: "I remember that in our hometown, a daughter's dowry is traditionally displayed before her marriage. This time, my dowry is being managed by Madame Qiao. I don't mean to suspect her, but I'm afraid she might cause trouble, and in the end, I would be the one at a disadvantage. So, I was thinking..."

Su Chengniang's expression grew more serious as she listened. Indeed, her daughter's dowry was a significant matter. How could she entrust such an important task to someone like Madame Qiao?

Her daughter had been sensible since she was young. When they first entered the Marquis's mansion, her daughter had advised her not to bring too many valuable items, fearing they might not be able to keep them safe.

She had followed her daughter's advice. Moreover, since learning that her daughter's marriage was settled, she had been busy these past few days, rummaging through everything, wishing she could take out all her savings to prepare a rich dowry for her daughter. She had already prepared a generous dowry for her daughter. The marriage was unavoidable, but she absolutely could not let her daughter be treated poorly in terms of the dowry.

However, her daughter was right. Since the Marquis's mansion had acknowledged her daughter, they must not allow anyone to take advantage of the dowry.

So, she nodded and said, "Don't worry. I will talk to him about this matter later. If he doesn't agree, then he must have something to hide."

Yu Qingzhi smiled slightly. With her mother handling it, she felt at ease. If she were to bring it up with her father herself, it would naturally be inappropriate. But if her mother did, her father would surely take it to heart.

The following days passed leisurely. To avoid giving anyone a reason to criticize, Madame Qiao appeared to be wholeheartedly preparing for Yu Qingzhi's wedding. When she was unsure about something, she would consult Madame Zhang, and even instructed her two daughters to get along well with Yu Qingzhi. The way the mistress of the household conducted herself was so open and above board that no one could find fault with it.

Yu Qingzhi also spent these days in leisure and comfort. When the mood struck her, she would sit on the swing in the courtyard, not forgetting to instruct Tong'er behind her to push her higher and higher.

Yu Qingyan, along with her younger sister Yu Qingying and the legitimate daughter of the fourth branch, Yu Qingning, arrived at the Wisteria Courtyard. As soon as they entered the courtyard, they saw this scene.

The fourteen-year-old girl swung on the swing, radiating a sprightly glow like a spirit. Her face bore a serene and content smile. Though her attire was not particularly eye-catching, it gave people an irresistible impression. Yu Qingyan looked at the scene and suddenly felt a pang of jealousy.

But she quickly adjusted her emotions and stepped forward with a smile, saying, "Third Sister, you are in such high spirits. With your wedding approaching, I thought you would be busy embroidering your wedding dress in your room all these days."

Yu Qingzhi was in the middle of enjoying her swing. Seeing the group enter, she couldn't help but feel a little disappointed, but she still signaled Tong'er to stop the swing and let her get off.

After steadying herself, she said to them, "Isn't the wedding dress being made by the embroidery workshop outside as Mother arranged? There's no need for me to do it myself. It's rare for Second Sister, Fourth Sister, and Fifth Sister to come visit me. Please, come inside and sit."

With that, she led them into the main hall.

After entering the main hall, Yu Qingying widened her eyes and carefully examined the furnishings in the room. The room was furnished with yellow rosewood furniture, exuding an air of wealth and grandeur. The treasures displayed on the cabinet were all valuable ornaments, and even the tea cups served by the maids were a matching set of old kiln doucai lotus tea cups. It was clear that she lived a very comfortable and carefree life.

Yu Qingying felt a pang of envy in her heart. Father really favored this illegitimate girl who had returned halfway. It was infuriating!

chapters.title: Provocation
chapters.content:
Thinking this in her heart, she unconsciously blurted out, "Father really favors Third Sister. Look at how richly this room is decorated. It seems like all the treasures of the Marquis's mansion have been moved to Third Sister's courtyard."

Yu Qingzhi understood her implication but did not engage in a verbal dispute. She just smiled faintly and sipped her tea.

Seeing that she had no reaction, Yu Qingying became even more annoyed. She pointed to a pair of blue and white cloud dragon pattern vases on the cabinet and said, "I have had my eye on those vases in Father's study for a long time. I asked Father for them several times, but he never gave them to me. Who would have thought that he would give them to Third Sister? I'm not satisfied. Can Third Sister lend them to me to play with for a few days?"

After saying this, she pouted and said, "Third Sister isn't so stingy, is she? Can't even lend out a single plaything?"

Yu Qingzhi still maintained her faint smile. "Of course, there's no problem. However, all the things on this cabinet were carefully selected by Father and placed here. He specifically told me that when I get married, these things will be included in my dowry.

But since Fourth Sister likes them, I will ask Father when he comes back tonight. As long as Father agrees, I can even give them to you. Oh, and if there's anything else you like, I can give it to you as long as I have the authority."

Seeing that she mentioned their father, Yu Qingying sulkily closed her mouth and said no more.

She had also been spoiled by Madame Qiao since she was young and had seen all kinds of fine things. However, seeing that Yu Qingzhi had received so many fine things made her feel resentful. She wanted to take a few things from her to balance her own emotions.

But if this caused their father to find out, she would likely be scolded for being greedy, which would be a loss.

After the group sat down and had a few sips of tea, Yu Qingyan put down her tea cup and said, "The reason we came today is to add to Third Sister's dowry. Although the wedding dress for the wedding day has been arranged by Mother to be made by the embroidery workshop outside, according to tradition, a bride must also prepare some handmade needlework to be displayed for others to see.

I was afraid that Third Sister, being young, might not understand these things. So today, I specifically brought a few embroidered items that I made myself to give to Third Sister. When the time comes, they can be placed together with Third Sister's, so that Third Sister will look better."

After saying this, she signaled the maid behind her to place the items she had brought onto the table.

Yu Qingyan pointed to the items on the table and continued, "These handkerchiefs, shoe uppers, and forehead cloths for the elders will be perfect to give to the in-laws. My embroidery skills are only passable, so please don't reject them, Third Sister. At least they are presentable.

Oh, and there's also this pair of gold earrings with red gemstones. I specifically found them because I thought they would match the bracelet I gave you earlier. So I brought them along as an additional dowry gift. Take a look and see if you like them."

Yu Qingzhi only glanced at them before quickly recalling the gaudy yet extravagant gold bracelet with kingfisher feathers and red gemstones that Yu Qingyan had given her before. Looking at the matching earrings in front of her, she couldn't help but twitch the corner of her mouth.

Well, at least these things were worth some money. If she ever needed money in the future, she could just sell them.

So she politely said, "Thank you, Second Sister. Then I won't stand on ceremony."

Yu Qingyan: "Between sisters, there's no need for thanks. It's just fate playing tricks. Who would have thought that Third Sister, being younger than me, would be the first to marry? It's quite embarrassing for me."

After saying this, she lowered her head in a feigned shy manner. In the eyes of the world, daughters in a family must marry in order of their seniority. If a younger sister marries first, the older sister is easily gossiped about, as if she is unmarriageable.

Yu Qingying chimed in, "Yes, Third Sister has only just returned and is already marrying before Second Sister. Someone who doesn't know might think that Third Sister is too eager."

After saying this, she simply laughed out loud, causing the even younger Yu Qingning to frown slightly.

Yu Qingzhi did not mince her words, "Yes, if outsiders mistakenly think that Second Sister has some hidden illness preventing her from marrying, that would be terrible.

However, outsiders don't understand how this marriage came about. Our own family knows the truth. If Second Sister and Fourth Sister feel that this is inappropriate, then we can inform Father and Grandmother and switch the order, letting Second Sister marry first. It doesn't matter to me."

This remark left Yu Qingyan and her sister momentarily speechless.

Yu Qingyan secretly glared at Yu Qingying and quickly smiled to smooth things over, "Fourth Sister speaks without thinking. Third Sister, don't learn from her. This marriage was divined by the Grandmaster of Tai Jue Temple, and the Old Madam of the General's mansion has also approved. How can it be changed so easily?"

Yu Qingying, rarely backing down, also followed suit, "Yes, how can a marriage be switched just like that? Third Sister, just consider it as my nonsense and don't take it to heart."

Seeing the atmosphere ease a bit, Yu Qingyan reminded Qingying and Qingning, "We've been talking so much, you two should present the dowry gifts you prepared for Third Sister."

Only then did Yu Qingying and Yu Qingning remember why they had come. They each instructed their maids to bring forward the gifts they had prepared.

Yu Qingying's gifts were also a few embroidered items. The craftsmanship and materials were far inferior to Yu Qingyan's, but she also included a pair of yellow jade carvings of mandarin duck heart-shaped pendants, strung with dark green cords embedded with gold beads, which looked dignified and elegant.

However, it was clear at a glance that such items were not suitable for a young girl to wear. Obviously, this was something Madame Qiao had given to her daughter to bring over for her own dowry.

Yu Qingning then pointed to the pair of cow horn combs inlaid with beryl stones she had brought and said to Yu Qingzhi, "I am still young and my embroidery skills are not good enough, so I won't show them. This pair of cow horn combs was a birthday gift from my cousin from my maternal grandmother's family last year. I hope Third Sister won't mind them."

Yu Qingning was the legitimate daughter of the fourth branch and was only eleven years old. She was still small and had not yet developed much. Perhaps due to the strict guidance of her wet nurse, she always liked to put on an air of dignity and steadiness in front of others, which was very mismatched with her age. Yu Qingzhi even felt tired on her behalf.

"Fifth Sister, your kindness is enough. Even if you sisters don't give me anything, I won't be unhappy. Moreover, I really like this pair of combs."

Yu Qingzhi smiled and ordered the maids to accept them.

Yu Qingning breathed a sigh of relief. She did not intend to deepen her relationship with this half-sister who had returned out of the blue. However, she could not neglect the surface-level courtesies, so she had casually picked something from her jewelry box and shown it to her mother before bringing it over.

Seeing that Yu Qingzhi had ordered the maids to put the gifts away, Yu Qingying's eyes rolled, and she said, "Since we're here, why not let us see what good things Third Sister has prepared? And what about embroidery? Surely Third Sister hasn't prepared any embroidery at all?"

From the time the engagement was set to now, it had been just over half a month. Although the mansion was preparing the dowry, the bride herself should also prepare some things, such as embroidery, which was unavoidable.

She didn't believe that Yu Qingzhi could embroider much in such a short time. At that time, she would naturally have to include the embroidery she and Second Sister had given to make up the numbers. Then, when there were many people around, she could accidentally let it slip, and the bride would lose face.

chapters.title: Dumbfounded
chapters.content:
The thought of finally making Yu Qingci lose face filled her with joy.

"How could it not be easy if you want to see?" she said, then had Tong'er bring out the embroidery she had been working on.

She was currently embroidering a pair of shoe uppers in indigo blue with pale moon lilac flowers, the lilacs so lifelike that the piece was nearly finished.

Yu Qingci pointed to her needlework and said, "This pair of shoe uppers is what I'm working on now, almost done. The other few pieces were just finished recently. Since time was tight, the embroidery is a bit rough, but it will pass."

Yu Qingyan and the others took them in hand to examine closely, silently comparing them to what they had brought. Soon, their hearts were filled with discomfort again. Was this what she called mediocre skill?

Yu Qingying couldn't believe it and asked, "Did you really embroider these yourself?"

Yu Qingci replied, "Of course. When I first returned to the manor, didn't I send each of you an embroidered handkerchief? Take it out and compare, then you'll know."

Yu Qingying was left speechless, her hands unconsciously clenching the embroidery.

Tong'er quickly snatched the embroidery from her hands, distressed. "Fourth Young Lady, please be careful. Our young lady worked hard, stitch by stitch, to make this."

Yu Qingying, embarrassed by Tong'er's sudden intervention, was about to lose her temper, but Yu Qingyan quickly blocked her and said with a smile, "Third Younger Sister's embroidery skills are indeed impressive. I suppose the preparations here are almost done as well. Why don't you show us?"

Yu Qingci didn't mind and stood up, leading everyone to the partitioned room where things were stored.

The dowry prepared by the Earl's Manor for her had always been kept in the public storage under Qiao Shi's management. It wouldn't be delivered to her courtyard until before the wedding. However, a daughter should also prepare some personal items in advance, such as embroidered gifts for the groom's family, which were the most important.

As they entered the partitioned room, they were immediately stunned by the sight before them. The room was filled with bright red silk and satin. In the middle, there were finished pieces in other colors: a fragrant satin quilt with golden thread and crabapple blossoms, embroidered shoes with pearl and jade lotus flowers, a red pillowcase with a full pool of begonia patterns, and a red brocade cover with intertwining peony branches. Various items covered the soft couch in the partitioned room, and a red sandalwood box on the side contained many more. The embroidery didn't need close inspection; at first glance, it was clear that each piece was meticulously crafted by a highly skilled embroideress.

The three sisters were dumbfounded. They hadn't expected this girl to have so many fine things. With embroidery like this, she could easily silence anyone by displaying just a few pieces. The embroidery they had brought was so inferior that it wasn't even worth comparing.

Yu Qingyan looked on with envy but pretended to sigh regretfully. "I didn't expect Sister to have so many fine things. It's just a pity that all this red will probably end up at the bottom of a trunk."

Yu Qingci replied, "These were all prepared for me by my mother. She said that since she couldn't personally arrange my wedding, she wanted to prepare more dowry so that no one would look down on me. Even if I don't use them in the future, they represent my mother's love and care."

Yu Qingying looked at the exquisite embroidery, her cheeks aching with anger. After thinking hard, she realized that Second Sister was right. No matter how fine the items were, no matter how rich the dowry, it was a pity that she was marrying a dead man. Once she entered the groom's family, she would have to spend her days alone, and all these vibrant, beautiful things would be useless, left at the bottom of a trunk.

Thinking of this, she felt a bit better and wanted to make a few more sarcastic remarks. However, Yu Qingyan secretly pinched her hand, forcing her to keep her mouth shut.

Yu Qingyan knew exactly what her younger sister was thinking. In truth, she shared the same sentiment. Normally, such exquisite embroidery would indeed be enviable, but for someone who would be widowed immediately after marriage, even if she brought all these dowry items with her, she wouldn't be able to display or use them. In this case, having them was no better than not having them at all.

As they left the Wisteria Courtyard, Yu Qingying finally blurted out in frustration, "This is so annoying! How did she end up with so many fine things? What does an illegitimate daughter like her deserve such a rich dowry for?"

Yu Qingyan quickly reminded her, "Shut up! Don't say anything about her being an illegitimate daughter again. Have you forgotten Mother's instructions?"

Yu Qingying pouted in a low voice, "But she is an illegitimate daughter. Just because her name is in the family genealogy, she thinks she's a legitimate daughter. I'll say it if I want to!"

Yu Qingyan seemed to shake her head helplessly. Just now, when she saw all that dowry, she had felt a pang of envy. But then she realized that most of it was just bedding, covers, and small trinkets for daily use. The real dowry was still under her mother's control.

Previously, she had thought that she would be the one getting married, and because her mother wasn't sure if the marriage arrangements would succeed, the dowry prepared for her was substantial and practical. But now that it was Yu Qingci instead, how could her mother possibly give her such a grand face?

In noble families, the preparation of a daughter's dowry had many intricacies. Some dowries might appear extremely rich on the surface, but upon closer inspection, they were far from impressive. She was waiting for the day when Yu Qingci would cry after getting married.

In the afternoon, as usual, Yu Qingci took Tong'er to the study in the outer courtyard to deliver tonic meals to her father and brother.

As she lifted the white porcelain bowl lid, a warm, fragrant aroma wafted out. Yu Qingbo, like a little puppy, exaggeratedly sniffed hard with his nose, then sat down, waiting for his sister to serve him a bowl.

Yu Jingxuan also looked at his daughter affectionately and said, "Qingci, how are the preparations for your things coming along? If you need any help from the manor's embroideresses, just let me know, and I'll personally instruct them to do a good job.

Also, you don't need to keep sending us these things. Qingbo and I have been getting a bit too well-fed lately."

Yu Qingci served her father a bowl and placed it on the table in front of him, saying, "Today, I made rock sugar, goji berry, and bird's nest porridge. It's quite light, so eating a little won't make you gain weight."

She then served her brother a bowl before sitting on the other side of the table, resting her chin on her hand as she watched her father and brother enjoy their meal.

Yu Jingxuan took a couple of bites and was about to compliment the porridge when he noticed his daughter's somewhat disheartened expression, as if she had something on her mind. He put down his spoon and asked, "What's wrong? Have you encountered any difficulties?"

Yu Qingci quickly perked up and said obediently, "It's nothing. I was just thinking that once I get married and leave, I won't have the chance to make tonic meals for you and my brother anymore. It makes me a little sad."

Yu Jingxuan and his son both felt a pang of sadness. Although Yu Qingbo was young, he had come to understand the reason for his sister's hasty marriage. He put down his spoon and looked at his sister, his eyes welling up with tears.

Seeing this, Yu Qingci quickly changed the subject and asked about Yu Qingbo's studies with Old Master Li.

Yu Qingbo recounted everything in detail. Currently, he was still in a probationary period and not yet considered Old Master Li's official disciple. Therefore, the master had stipulated that he go once every other day, spending the entire day at the master's place. He would study in the morning and then help the master tend to the garden in the afternoon.

These days, he had been strictly following the master's rules and going on time. For the rest of the time, he still attended the clan school, ensuring that neither was neglected. For this, his father had specially prepared a carriage and two attendants to take him to and from his lessons.

Yu Qingci said, "Do whatever Old Master Li arranges for you. Whether it's studying or farming, you must do it seriously and not slack off."

Yu Qingbo nodded understandingly. "I know. These past few days, following the master to plow the fields and plant vegetables has actually been quite interesting. The master says that farming is the foundation of all things. Even the emperor must sincerely perform the plowing ceremony to set an example for the nation, let alone us ordinary people. Yesterday, the master even praised me, saying 'This child is teachable!'"

Yu Qingbo lifted his small chin with a hint of pride.

Yu Qingci smiled. "My brother is the best."

"But... if only Sister didn't have to get married. I still can't bear to part with you."

At the thought of his sister's upcoming marriage, Yu Qingbo immediately felt sad again. He shot an unhappy glance at his father beside him, and the atmosphere instantly returned to its previous heaviness.

Seeing this, Tong'er interjected, "Young Master need not be sad. Even after the young lady leaves, if you miss her, you can go to the General's Manor to visit. I don't believe the people at the General's Manor would dare to stop you, would they?

But speaking of the young lady, it's already a great injustice that she has to marry under these circumstances. And now, Third Young Lady keeps calling her an illegitimate daughter. It's truly too much!"

Yu Jingxuan's face darkened immediately upon hearing this. "What's going on?"

Yu Qingci tried to cover it up, but Tong'er paid no heed and quickly blurted out everything that Yu Qingyan and Yu Qingying had said in front of the Wisteria Courtyard.

Yu Jingxuan's face turned as black as the bottom of a pot after listening. "Qingying is getting more and more out of line. Don't worry, this time I will definitely discipline her properly."

Yu Qingci, being understanding, said, "Forget it, Father. I won't take it to heart. Anyway, I'm getting married soon, so enduring a little hardship doesn't matter. I'm more worried about my brother. Father, you've never officially announced my brother's status to the outside world. Naturally, people will speculate wildly about us siblings. I'm afraid that over time, the rumors will become even more unsavory and have a bad influence on my brother."

Yu Jingxuan understood the implication in his daughter's words, and his face showed even more guilt. He wasn't unwilling to make their status public. Ever since the ancestral hall was opened, he had brought up this matter with his mother several times. Each time, his mother had told him to wait, using the excuse that she didn't want the Earl's Manor to attract too much attention. With Qiao Shi also chiming in, he had gradually forgotten about it.

Now, it seemed that he could no longer delay. Some things needed to be announced to the public as soon as possible.

As they left the study, the mistress and servant walked to a secluded spot. Tong'er lowered her voice and asked, "Miss, how was what I said earlier? The Master's face was so dark and foul just now. I bet Fourth Young Lady is in for some trouble."

Yu Qingci smiled knowingly. "You did well. I'll reward you when we get back."

Tong'er was even more delighted. "Miss should be like this. If they dare to make us suffer, we'll just go to the Master for support. Who's afraid of whom?"

Yu Qingci neither agreed nor disagreed. She had intentionally arranged for Tong'er to mention the term "illegitimate daughter" to her father, not just to have him punish Yu Qingying. From her father's reaction just now, he should know what to do.

Thinking about Qiao Shi and her daughters' likely reactions next, Yu Qingci couldn't help but secretly look forward to it.

Yu Jingxuan arrived early at Shouyin Hall to pay his respects to his mother. The younger generations from each branch had already arrived before him.

chapters.title: Dowry List
chapters.content:
Madame Zhang was seated at the head of the table, looking at the room filled with her children and grandchildren, her heart filled with immense satisfaction.

After the old Earl passed away, the two concubine-born sons had been sent away early. Now, the children, daughters-in-law, grandchildren, and granddaughters who gathered around her knees were all her own flesh and blood. It was rare for them to all come together to pay their respects to her like this.

After all, a wedding was about to take place, and the bride was not a particularly close granddaughter. Madame Zhang's expression showed neither joy nor sorrow, but she smiled warmly and asked everyone to sit down and chat with her.

Madame Zhang casually asked Qiao Shi, "Tomorrow is the day to send the dowry. How are the preparations on your end?"

According to the customs of the current dynasty, the day before the wedding was when the bride's family would send the dowry to the groom's family. Since Yu Qingci's wedding was set for the day after tomorrow, all the dowry would be delivered to the General's Manor tomorrow.

Qiao Shi quickly replied, "Mother, rest assured. All the dowry has been prepared. There are a total of sixty-eight palanquins' worth, including jewelry, furniture, fabrics, and silks. Nothing is missing. I've also prepared a small estate and two shops in the capital.

Oh, and the servants to be given as part of the dowry have also been arranged. Here is the dowry list. Please take a look, Mother."

As she spoke, Qiao Shi handed over a small, gold-embossed booklet.

Madame Zhang opened it and began to read. Qiao Shi stood beside her, pointing and explaining each item. Madame Zhang nodded repeatedly, clearly satisfied.

After finishing the dowry list, Madame Zhang casually handed it to Yu Jingxuan, who was seated at the lower end of the table. "Your wife has put in a lot of effort. The dowry prepared for Qingci is quite presentable. Compared to the legitimate daughters of other noble families in the capital, it's not lacking in any way. Earl, you take a look as well, so you don't think that our Earl's Manor has treated Qingci poorly."

Yu Jingxuan took the list and began to flip through it. Qiao Shi couldn't help but feel a sense of pride.

Could anyone tell the quality of the items just from a list? She could produce every single item listed. Unless someone was a long-time manager of household affairs, it would be difficult to spot any tricks.

She didn't believe that the Earl, a man who was always away from home and never involved in household matters, could see through anything.

However, seeing Yu Jingxuan holding the list and examining it carefully, Qiao Shi still felt a bit nervous. So, she explained beside him:

"In the capital, the daughters of noble and prominent families usually have a dowry of sixty or seventy palanquins. Families with slightly lesser status often have thirty or forty. Our Earl's Manor has prepared a full sixty-eight palanquins for Qingci. With such a presentable dowry, no one can say anything against it. It wouldn't be an exaggeration to call it a 'ten-li red dowry.' When Qingci marries into her husband's family, she will surely be held in high regard."

Yu Jingxuan flipped through the list from beginning to end, seemingly satisfied. He put down the list and said, "Madam, you've worked hard. I have one more thing to discuss with Mother. Before sending the dowry tomorrow, to make it more auspicious, we could follow the custom from Yuyang and display the dowry publicly. We can open all the trunks in front of relatives and friends, letting them bear witness."

As soon as these words were spoken, the entire hall was shocked. Qiao Shi blurted out, "What? Open the trunks in public? Earl, do you want to display the dowry publicly? Why? Do you not trust me, Earl?"

Madame Zhang also reacted at this point and asked, "What's the matter, Earl? Why did you suddenly think of displaying the dowry? I have heard that some places do have such customs, but it's rarely done in our capital."

Yu Jingxuan explained, "Mother, Qingci was born in Yuyang and grew up there. In Yuyang, it's customary to display the dowry. It's both for good fortune and to show care for the daughter. Although we're back in the capital now, since we've prepared such a rich dowry for Qingci, why not follow the Yuyang custom and make it a lively event?"

Seeing that Madame Zhang remained silent, Yu Jingxuan continued, "As Mother just said, Qingci returned home partway and, although her name is in the family genealogy, we have kept her and her brother's status low-key and never publicly announced it. Now that she is about to get married and we have prepared a decent dowry for her, we should let the world know.

This is also a matter of our Earl's Manor's reputation. We must let those outsiders know how much we value this marriage."

Qiao Shi became even more anxious. "This cannot be done!"

chapters.title: The Dowry List (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Qiao Shi regained her composure and forced a smile. "Lord Bo also said it's a custom from Youyang, but this is the capital. Here, we don’t have the tradition of displaying the dowry. I think it’s better to keep things low-key. There’s no need to let outsiders see every single item in the dowry. I’m sure San Jiao would not want her dowry exposed for all to see, am I right, San Jiao?"

Qiao Shi looked at Yu Qingci with eager eyes, hoping she would step in to dissuade Lord Bo.

Seeing everyone’s gaze on her, Yu Qingci lowered her head, a shy expression on her face. "When I was little, I didn’t understand and went to join the crowd to watch a neighbor’s sister display her dowry. I was quite envious. At the time, Father said that when I grew up and got married, I would have such a moment too. So I don’t think there’s anything wrong with it. In fact, I find it rather interesting. I will listen to Father in everything."

Yu Jingcheng looked at Yu Qingci with even more affection. He had no memory of the incident she mentioned, but he knew his daughter must support this idea. After all, it was her mother who had proposed it, not something he had come up with on a whim.

Cheng Niang had nearly severed ties with him over this marriage. He had gone to great lengths to coax her into even looking at him again. Later, when Cheng Niang proposed displaying the dowry publicly, he agreed without hesitation.

Cheng Niang had said that it had been hard enough raising her daughter to adulthood, and now, before she could even have her coming-of-age ceremony, she was being forced to marry into that kind of place. The thought pained her deeply. She had promised her daughter that when the time came for her marriage, she would prepare a generous dowry that would make all the guests envious.

Yu Jingcheng already felt guilty about his daughter’s marriage. Since Cheng Niang had brought it up, he simply agreed. Although displaying the dowry wasn’t a common practice in the capital, it wasn’t unheard of. He remembered that a few years ago, the daughter of a Ministry of Rites official who had returned from the south had displayed her dowry publicly.

After seeing the dowry list, he felt even more confident. The Bo family had prepared a rich dowry for their daughter. Displaying it publicly would bring honor to the Bo family and also satisfy Cheng Niang. It was a win-win situation.

Yu Jingcheng made up his mind and waved his hand decisively. "It’s settled then. Tomorrow, when the relatives and friends arrive, we’ll find a spacious place to display all the dowry items so they can see for themselves that our Bo family’s daughter is marrying off in grand style."

Zhang Shi nodded in agreement. "Since Lord Bo has decided, let’s make it lively. Qiao Shi, arrange it carefully to avoid any mishaps with so many people around."

Before Qiao Shi could respond, Yu Jingcheng added, "What mishaps could there be? It’s a simple matter—just add more hands to help."

Then, he solemnly instructed Qiao Shi, "By the way, the estate and the shops must be displayed prominently. Write down clearly how many acres of prime land there are, their locations, the size of the estate, and the number of tenant households that will go with it. For the shops, specify their locations, whether they are two or three stories, and how many people, including the manager and the clerks, will be included. Also, place all the deeds for the servants and maids openly so that everything is clear at a glance."

He was afraid that Qiao Shi, inexperienced in such matters, might not know the details, so he explained everything carefully.

But as she listened, Qiao Shi’s face grew paler and paler. By the time Yu Jingcheng and Zhang Shi had finished their instructions, her forehead was beaded with sweat, and her face was ashen. She barely managed to stay on her feet.

After the two finished their instructions, Qiao Shi responded with a "yes" and then excused herself, claiming she had many tasks to attend to.

The Fourth Madam, Liu Shi, had been listening with amusement. Seeing Qiao Shi’s ghostly expression, she couldn’t help but smirk inwardly. She feigned concern and asked, "Elder Sister, what’s wrong? You look so pale. Have you been overworked with the wedding preparations?"

At these words, everyone turned to look at Qiao Shi.

Qiao Shi tightly clutched the handkerchief in her hand and forced a smile. "I’m fine. I was just thinking about how many people we need to prepare for tomorrow’s dowry display."

Liu Shi said, "Elder Sister, you’ve indeed worked hard for Qingci’s marriage. If you’re too busy, just let me know. We’re sisters-in-law; there’s no need to stand on ceremony. It would be terrible if you fell ill from overwork."

Liu Shi’s words were polite, but her expression was one of someone watching a good show. She hadn’t lifted a finger from start to finish, so why should she be the one to worry?

The management of the Bo family’s household had always been in Qiao Shi’s hands. Although the Fourth Branch was also born of the Old Madam, the Bo family belonged to the Eldest Branch. After years of interaction, Liu Shi knew exactly what kind of person Qiao Shi was. For many years, Liu Shi had lived under Qiao Shi’s shadow, and over time, she had endured many slights.

Initially, everyone had assumed that the one to be married off would be Qiao Shi’s biological daughter, Yu Qingyan, and that she would naturally spare no effort in preparing a generous dowry for her.

But now, it was the daughter of the original wife, Su Chengniang. How could Qiao Shi be willing to provide such a rich dowry for her?

Naturally, she would try to cut corners wherever possible. Of course, with Qiao Shi’s cleverness, as long as no one deliberately checked each item against the list, no one would notice anything amiss.
